summary: This is an 8-K filed by PIMCO Asset-Based Lending Co LLC reporting unregistered sales of equity securities under Items 3.02 and 8.01. On April 1, 2026, the company issued and sold various classes of limited liability company interests to third-party investors for cash, with final share counts determined on April 28, 2026. The aggregate consideration for Series II alone was approximately $44.2 million. It also discloses net asset values per share and distribution declarations. This is a routine capital raise by a closed-end fund, not a special-situation event. No special situation elements such as acquisitions, activist campaigns, or restructuring are present.
